user: OK. What documents do I need to prepare for the dispute?
answer:
For a goods-not-received dispute on TX-0401, the knowledge base lists these supporting documents:

- **Order confirmation** from the merchant
- **Delivery record**, such as a tracking record showing no delivery, if you have one
- **Correspondence with the merchant** about the order and the non-delivery

Only some of these may be requested, but if Verta asks for evidence and you don't supply it within 7 calendar days, the case will be declined. Gather these now so you can respond quickly.

I also ran the eligibility check under **goods_not_received**, since you reported that the goods were never received. It passed on all criteria: reason code, transaction status, filing window, and compliance. The filing deadline is **18 October 2026**. My earlier summary mentioned service_not_rendered, but that code applies to services, so goods_not_received is the better fit here.

The dispute is not open yet. If you want me to file it under goods_not_received for the full amount of TX-0401, please confirm and I will open it.

Payment dispute rules
## Reason codes and chargeback windows
Each dispute reason code has its own window, counted in days from the
transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

Glossary
## Provisional credit
A temporary refund applied while a dispute is reviewed; reversed if the dispute
is declined.

Dispute handling process
## Raising a dispute
A dispute is raised against a single settled transaction. The customer supplies
the transaction reference and a reason code. The agent verifies eligibility
before the case is opened; an ineligible request is refused with the failing
condition named, except where confidentiality rules apply.
